about.title: About Adal Qogam
about.intro: An intelligent reference and navigation tool for the Constitution of the Republic of Kazakhstan, its laws and state policy in domestic affairs and ideological work. The bot finds official information for your question, explains it in plain Kazakh, Russian or English, and points to the original source.
about.step1Text: Type or dictate your question in any of the three languages. You can attach a document or a photo.
about.step2Text: The question is turned into a vector and the system finds the closest passages of official documents in MongoDB Atlas.
about.step3Text: The Gemini model writes the answer only from the retrieved passages and cites the document and article.
about.step4Text: If nothing relevant is found in the base, the model is not called at all: the bot honestly says there is no information.
about.docsModeText: Answers strictly from the uploaded official documents. The most accurate mode, on by default.
about.webModeText: The bot also searches the web (Google Search). Answers are broader but less accurate: web information is marked and not verified against official documents.
about.baseText: The official documents the bot answers from. Links lead to the reference texts in the Adilet legal database.
about.conceptsText: The bot explains the values and principles of domestic policy and points out when a concept is enshrined in the Constitution.

concepts.c7: Strong President – Influential Parliament – Accountable Government

about.privacyText: Analytics is anonymous: question texts are never stored there. Passwords are kept only as scrypt hashes and API keys stay on the server. Requests are rate-limited to prevent abuse.
